item.title: Missing Alabama student James Gracey found dead and more top headlines
item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: WATCH: Dem senators make the case for the very bill they're trying to kill
item.summary: Senators Schumer and Warnock acknowledged noncitizen voting exists but argued it is too rare to justify the SAVE America Act's citizenship requirements.

item.title: Far-left firebrand dodges questions over hiring bodyguard with criminal history
item.summary: Despite rebuffing questions about the hiring process, Rep. Crockett says her office followed House vetting protocols but admits her bodyguard's criminal history was unknown to her.

item.title: High Point's Chase Johnston delivers faithful message after scoring game-winning March Madness upset basket
item.summary: Following a thrilling upset, High Point guard Chase Johnston pointed to his faith in Jesus Christ, reflecting the Panthers’ deep spiritual bond and team-first mentality.

item.title: Top Dems brush off ties to Imam who held memorial for Iranian leader who vowed 'Death to America'
item.summary: Former President Bill Clinton, Kamala Harris and Michigan Democrats photographed with radical Iranian-born Imam respond to questions after Fox News Digital inquiry leads to photo purge.

item.title: Canadian opposition leader tells Rogan 'fake refugees' are straining economy, must be dealt with lawfully
item.summary: Canadian opposition leader Pierre Poilievre told Joe Rogan that Canada brought in roughly a million people a year, causing a housing crisis and economic strain.

item.title: Jimmy Gracey's death deemed accidental after vanishing on spring break in Barcelona, police say
item.summary: Spanish police say Jimmy Gracey, a 20-year-old University of Alabama student, died accidentally in Barcelona after vanishing near Shoko nightclub.

item.title: Pittsburgh Public Schools moves to remote learning ahead of NFL Draft
item.summary: Pittsburgh Public Schools announced that it would be shifting to remote learning out of concerns for "transportation challenges" during the 2026 NFL Draft.

item.title: Exclusive: Ohio gubernatorial candidate blasts NFL fans over COVID rules in resurfaced posts
item.summary: OutKick exclusively obtained deleted posts from Amy Acton showing the Ohio gubernatorial candidate used the pandemic to lecture NFL fans for simply talking about football.

item.title: FCC takes notice as America’s most popular sport becomes increasingly costly, frustrating to consume
item.summary: NFL fans who want to access every game need YouTube TV for “NFL Sunday Ticket," along with costly subscriptions to Amazon Prime, Peacock and Netflix.
